tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Time-slices are smooth manifolds with a complementary horizontal subbundle] ↗ def:surgery-space-time

Every time-slice $M_t$ is a smooth $n$-manifold. Its tangent bundle embeds as a codimension-one subbundle of $T{\mathcal M}|_{M_t}$ complementary to the line spanned by $\chi $; these subbundles vary smoothly and form a global horizontal subbundle.

Proof

\sketch In each chart, $M_t$ is an ordinary coordinate slice and its tangent space is the kernel of $d{\bf t}$, complementary to $\chi $ because $\chi ({\bf t})=1$. The local descriptions agree under the overlap maps.

□
